name: slate
description: Connect Codex to the governed Slate canvas API on the installed O-Matic Server.

interface.shortDescription: Use the installed O-Matic Server's governed Slate canvas API.
interface.longDescription: A narrow proxy for Slate canvas, version, restore, and bounded asset operations. The server remains the authority for bearer-token authentication, factory grants, tenant isolation, and audit records. This package adds no database credential and no browser secret.
defaultPrompt: Check whether the Slate API is ready.
Create a Slate canvas for this work.
Save the current Slate canvas as a new revision.
